pages.text: $(item)Magnatite Ore$() lies deep underground, mostly in deepslate, and needs a diamond pickaxe. It is a little easier to find than diamond. As with the other ores, keep the ore block: the machine takes it as it is.$(br2)The $(l:machines/magnetic_centrifuge)Magnetic Centrifuge$() spins each ore into Magnatite Nuggets and one $(item)Carbon Dust$().
Nine nuggets make a $(item)Magnatite Ingot$() by hand or in the Combination Forge.
Fit the $(item)Copper Tetrium Coil$() to a centrifuge and it can magnetise ingots into $(item)Charged Magnatite Ingots$(). Each try may fail; a failed try keeps the ingot.
